import.title: Bulk asset import from Excel
import.description: Upload assigned assets and unassigned inventory in the same file. Leave the employee national ID and assignment dates empty to create unassigned inventory. The issue date is required when an employee is provided. After uploading, map the columns and run the import.
import.loadError: The asset import template could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
import.unavailable: The asset import template is unavailable. Contact your administrator to check your import permissions.
